messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm putting together the internal release note + brief for tomorrow's deploy. Thinking of a short digest + 'lazy rollout' cadence (small % for 2 hours, then stepped increase). Need sign-off on wording and the pin/rollback lanes.
kevin: lazy rollout sounds good for low-risk changes. What's the pinned model/version we should reference?
sophia: I can take copy editing. Can you drop the draft here, Maria?
ryan: We should pin to model: inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d (the -d variant has the low-memory quantization). Rollback plan: immediate revert to v3.2.0 with traffic cutover and invalidate KV cache.
maria: Draft below — brief and short ops checklist: 
```
Internal release: Compact slate — incremental rollout
When: 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC (change window)
Canary: 5% traffic for 2h -> 25% for 1h -> 100% if no regressions
Model pin: inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d
Rollback: switch to inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.0 + flush prefix cache
Notes: Performance wins on long sequences, minor tokenizer change (backwards-compatible)
Owners: @maria, @kevin, @ryan (oncall)
```
kevin: Nice. Two nits: add deploybot cue and call out metric watchlist (latency p95, token-cost, hallucination rate on core prompt set). Also add a short line that user-facing copy doesn't change (no UI changes).
sophia: Edited copy suggestion below, trimmed for the staff digest: 
"Tomorrow we will roll v3.2.1-d using a staged rollout. Expect lower token cost on long sequences. Ops will monitor p95 latency, embed/response error rates, and prompt-eval regressions. Rollback is to v3.2.0 and will include a KV cache flush. Standby roster: Kevin, Ryan, Maria."

maria: Perfect. I'll paste this into the internal announce channel once we pin final times. One question for @deploy-bot: can you schedule the canary and auto-post the canary cue to #eng-oncall and trigger the deploy window? Also set a 2h canary timer.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maria: canary start 2026-03-22T18:00:00Z, policy: staged (5% -> 25% -> 100%), canary timeout: 2h. Notifying channels: #eng-oncall, #eng-sre. To cancel: /deploy cancel 5991234567.
ryan: Thanks deploy-bot. Small ops note: Kevin, please prewarm KV shards for the canary region. Also include a quick smoke test step in the runbook: send 50 short and 50 long requests to verify latency and token-cost delta.
kevin: On it — prewarming now. Runbook smoke snippet I'll paste here in case ops wants it: 
```
# smoke tests (post-canary-start)
for i in range(50): curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/gen -d '{"model":"inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d","prompt":"short"}'
for i in range(50): curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/gen -d '{"model":"inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d","prompt":"<long prompt ~1k tokens>"}'
```
sophia: LGTM. I'll be on standby for copy push and the internal announce once Maria posts. Add :thumbsup: reaction to this thread when you're good.
maria: Posting internal announce at T-minus 30m. Final announce copy (one-paragraph) below — use for the staff digest: 
"Heads-up: We will roll model inference/redwood-serve@v3.2.1-d on 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC using a staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Expected improvements: lower per-token cost for long inputs and consistent p95 latency. No user-visible UI changes. Ops will monitor latency p95, token cost, and prompt-eval regressions; rollback plan is immediate revert to v3.2.0 + KV cache flush. Standby roster: Maria, Kevin, Ryan. See internal runbook for steps and cancellation."

kevin: :thumbsup: Looks good. I'll add the metric dashboards to the announce thread before you post.
ryan: Ready for canary window. If we see >10% regression on hallucination metric or latency p95 +100ms, initiate rollback.
maria: Thanks team — posting now. Will ping back here after canary starts with the deploy-bot confirmation. :rocket:
